title: Deciphering Implicit Hate: Evaluating Automated Detection Algorithms for Multimodal Hate*

bias_targets.methodology: Including a "Reclaimed" speech category in the dataset taxonomy and conducting qualitative error analysis to evaluate whether the automated models disproportionately misclassify African American vernacular (e.g., reclaimed slurs commonly used by Black communicators) as hateful or mistakenly classify hateful uses as neutral.
